mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, type, color, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, created_by, update_time, updated_by FROM tags ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, code, type, color, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, created_by, update_time, updated_by FROM tags WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, code, type, color, sort_order, status, product_count, create_time, created_by, update_time, updated_by FROM tags WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (name, code, type, color, sort_order, status, create_time, created_by, update_time, updated_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{type}, #{color}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updateTime}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, title, image, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, product_code, stock, weight, volume, create_time, update_time FROM products WHERE tag_id = #{tagId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET tag_id = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{productId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
UPDATE tags t SET product_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.tag_id = t.id)
